allow: PowerShell($env:PATH += ";C:\\Program Files\\GitHub CLI"; "`n" | gh auth login --web --git-protocol https --hostname github.com 2>&1)

PowerShell(Write-Output "=== 代理环境变量 ==="; Write-Output "HTTP_PROXY=$env:HTTP_PROXY"; Write-Output "HTTPS_PROXY=$env:HTTPS_PROXY"; Write-Output "ALL_PROXY=$env:ALL_PROXY"; Write-Output "=== 测试 github.com ==="; curl.exe -sI --max-time 12 https://github.com 2>&1 | Select-Object -First 1; Write-Output "=== 测试 api.github.com ==="; curl.exe -sI --max-time 12 https://api.github.com 2>&1 | Select-Object -First 1; Write-Output "=== 测试 github.com/login ==="; curl.exe -sI --max-time 12 https://github.com/login 2>&1 | Select-Object -First 1)

PowerShell($ips = @\('140.82.112.3','140.82.113.4','140.82.114.4'\); foreach\($ip in $ips\){ $r = curl.exe -sI --max-time 6 --resolve github.com:443:$ip https://github.com/login 2>&1 | Select-Object -First 1; Write-Output "IP $ip => $r" }; Write-Output "=== 探测本机代理端口 ==="; foreach\($p in 7890,7897,1080,10809,2080,8888,8080\){ $t = New-Object Net.Sockets.TcpClient; try { $t.Connect\('127.0.0.1',$p\); Write-Output "代理端口 $p : 开放"; $t.Close\(\) } catch { Write-Output "代理端口 $p : 关闭" } })

PowerShell($isAdmin = \([Security.Principal.WindowsPrincipal][Security.Principal.WindowsIdentity]::GetCurrent\(\)\).IsInRole\([Security.Principal.WindowsBuiltInRole]::Administrator\); Write-Output "管理员权限: $isAdmin"; Write-Output "=== 当前 hosts 中 github 相关条目 ==="; $h = "C:\\Windows\\System32\\drivers\\etc\\hosts"; Get-Content $h | Select-String -Pattern "github" ; Write-Output "=== hosts 文件末尾 3 行 ==="; Get-Content $h | Select-Object -Last 3)
PowerShell($env:PATH += ";C:\\Program Files\\GitHub CLI"; $env:HTTPS_PROXY='http://127.0.0.1:8787'; gh auth status)

PowerShell(Write-Output "=== 代理进程是否还在 ==="; $t = New-Object Net.Sockets.TcpClient; try { $t.Connect\('127.0.0.1',8787\); Write-Output "代理 8787: 运行中"; $t.Close\(\) } catch { Write-Output "代理 8787: 已停止（需要重启）" })
